about: Held-out intent probe v4. Written on 2026-10-25 AFTER the intent rules were frozen in commit d95efad and committed before it was scored. Scored once; not used for tuning. New traps beyond v2/v3: questions about deletion, conditional threats, removing other content than the account, and 'keep the account, change one thing' in eight languages.
